newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: GOLF-CHALMERS LEADS QUEENSLAND OPEN WITH OPENING 65.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-CHALMERS LEADS QUEENSLAND OPEN WITH OPENING 65.

text.p: Australian Greg Chalmers birdied his first five holes and carded a five-under-par 65 for a one stroke first round lead in the A$200,000 (US$158,000) Queensland Open on Thursday.
Chalmers covered the first nine holes in just 29 strokes, including 11 putts, and finished one short of the course record.
Compatriot Marcus Cain filled second place with New Zealanders Michael Long and Steve Alker and Craig Jones of Australia one back.
